item.title: Sit & Stitch 3:30 to 5:30 — Mon Aug 17, 3:30 PM — Guerneville Regional Library
item.description: Sit & Stitch on every Monday starting on Monday, July 13th between 3:30 and 5:30 PM. You can drop in for any amount of time. We have the supplies to help people get started on needle felting, knitting, macrame, and crocheting. We will also have tea, so bring your favorite covered drink container. Sit and Stitch is for people to come and work on any fiber arts activity that they have while visiting with others. Most people will bring their own projects, but we always have hooks, needles, and yarn and sometimes we will offer a project with instructions that people may choose to make. Let us know what you would like to learn this year. We now have a working sewing machine for people to use. For beginners, I will bring is some fabric to make pillowcases. If you have a project that you would like to work on, bring in your fabric and thread and you can use the machine. We share ideas, skills, and encouragement with each other. item.title: Healdsburg Senior Center Book Club — Tue Aug 18, 10:00 AM — Healdsburg Senior Center
item.description:
Join us on the Third Tuesday of the month at 10:00 am as we discuss different books! Print Copies will be available in the branch a month before the discussion. Please call or email the library with any questions. Book Club titles and dates are subject to change. For up to date information visit: sonomalibrary.org/bookclubs 2026 Schedule January 20 - North Woods by Daniel Mason February 17 - The Housemaid by Freida McFadden March 17 - Three Bags Full by Leonie Swann April 21 - Maid by Stephanie Land May 19 - Good Night Irene by Luis Alberto Urrea June 16 - Nightshade by Michael Connelly July 21 - Daisy Darker by Alice Feeney August 18 - My Friends by Fredrick Backman September 15 - The Truth According to Ember by Danica Nava October 20 - A Marriage at Sea by Sophie Elmhirst November 17 - Anita de Monte Laughs Last by Xociti Gonzalez December 15 - TBD
Source: North Bay Bohemian
